name: Isle of Kinara
source:
Isle of Kinara is a story-driven adult visual novel focused on guided progression, ritual-based escalation, and character bonding.
Stranded on a mysterious island, you are drawn into a structured path of discipline, trust, and transformation.
translation:
《基纳拉岛》是一部以剧情为主的成人视觉小说，注重循序引导的流程、通过仪式逐步加深的体验，以及人物间的羁绊。
你困在一座神秘岛屿上，逐渐踏上了一条有明确规矩的道路，学习服从与信任，也经历自身的转变。
